# Claude Code configuration

Verified 2026-10-28 against [settings files and precedence](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings). Check the installed CLI with `claude --version` and `claude --help`; available keys and organization policy can differ by version.

Use `.claude/settings.json` for shared project settings and `.claude/settings.local.json` for personal project overrides. User settings live in `~/.claude/settings.json`; organization-managed settings can constrain lower-level configuration. Do not assume a project setting overrides managed policy.

```json
{
  "permissions": {
    "deny": ["Read(.env)"]
  }
}
```

This is an illustrative project permission rule, not a complete secret-management policy. Merge supported keys with existing configuration; do not replace the entire file. Use the host's configuration UI to inspect what loaded. Keep personal credentials outside committed settings.

AgentKit roles omit `model` so the session supplies it. Do not paste old model IDs or unsupported token, temperature or memory keys into project settings. If the task requires a model override, verify the available setting and selected model first.

Hook lifecycle settings belong under `hooks` in the settings file; read [hooks and plugins](hooks-and-plugins.md). Project MCP servers use root `.mcp.json`; read [MCP integration](mcp-integration.md). These are separate configuration surfaces, not a single generic config file.
